name: the reported divergence count
source: sheet-structure-scan scan 4 on the UNFCCC calculator: 21 DIVERGED of 23 testable relationships (SSS_033, SSS_034). Clocks from claim-record/records/SSS_017.json and UNF_GRID_IRAQ.json.
_note: S6 H4 asks for a term with two conflicting level clocks. This one
has them and neither is invented: the reading rests on a reader
revised twice in one day and on workbook contents whose neglected
term turns over in years. Both time constants are recorded in the
claim registry, measured or stated there, and are quoted here.
They are not reconciled and no shelf life is derived from the pair.
The point of S5 is that a term whose levels disagree on horizon is
the finding, so collapsing them would delete it.

levels.severed: the parser revision that produced the count
levels.still_acting: the reader keeps changing; a count from an earlier revision is a different measurement (SSS_017: 129 of 825 before repair, 825 after)

clock.basis: sheetmodel.py was revised twice on 2026-08-25; taken as 0.003 years and measured only over one day (claim-record SSS_017)

quantified.by: claim-record SSS_017: two revisions observed on 2026-08-25, taken as 0.003 years

levels.severed: the workbook contents the count is taken over
levels.still_acting: the generation mix behind each factor keeps turning over; the workbook does not re-read it

clock.basis: the neglected term of the factors being counted, stated in the delivery and taken as 3 (claim-record UNF_GRID_IRAQ)

quantified.by: stated in the delivery and taken as 3; not computed here

levels.still_acting: the count is quoted as a property of the workbook

levels.goal: characterise how well a workbook's prose and its cells agree
levels.severed: the relation between one workbook's count and any general rate
levels.still_acting: n is 1, and a point is not a rate (SSS_035)

plan.why: the work order states what the scan is for and the scan's own selftest checks that it does it; both are in the repository

_enumeration_note: both downward levels are the neglected terms named in the claim records the reading rests on: claim-record SSS_017 names the reader revision, UNF_GRID_IRAQ names the generation mix.
